question: What Is Zax Sauce?
quick_answer: Zax Sauce is Zaxby's signature dipping sauce, made for its Chicken Fingerz. It is a creamy, tangy sauce with hints of garlic and Worcestershire, often compared to a cross between fry sauce and ranch. The exact recipe is secret, but since 2024 you can buy bottles of Zax Sauce, Spicy Zax Sauce and Tongue Torch at some Southern grocery stores and online.

body.heading: What Zax Sauce is
body.text: Zax Sauce is the house dip that Zaxby's serves with its chicken fingers, and it has been on the menu since the first restaurant. Zaxby's started as ZAX in Georgia around 1990, founded by childhood friends Zach McLeroy and Tony Townley, and the sauce still carries the original name. Zaxby's says it was made to be the perfect sauce for Chicken Fingerz, but people use it on fries, sandwiches and wings too.

body.heading: What it tastes like
body.text: Zax Sauce is creamy and tangy, with a blend of seasonings but no real heat. Reviewers often say it smells a lot like ranch, and some compare it to fry sauce, the mayo-and-ketchup mix found in the West. Food writers who have tasted the bottled version also picked up garlic and Worcestershire.

body.heading: What's in it
body.text: Zaxby's has never shared the full recipe and says it is so secret that it is locked in a vault. The bottled version's label lists egg, soy and wheat as allergens, which points to a mayonnaise base with seasonings. Copycat recipes online usually combine mayonnaise, ketchup, Worcestershire sauce, garlic powder and black pepper.

body.heading: Every Zaxby's sauce
body.text: Zaxby's has around a dozen sauces, and the lineup changes from time to time. Dips include Zax Sauce, Spicy Zax Sauce, Ranch and Honey Mustard. Wing sauces include BBQ, Teriyaki, Sweet & Spicy, Hot Honey Mustard and the hot ones: Wimpy, Tongue Torch, Buffalo Garlic Blaze, Nuclear and Insane. Spicy Zax Sauce is a favorite in many rankings because it keeps the creamy Zax flavor and adds real heat.

body.heading: Can you buy Zax Sauce in stores?
body.text: Yes. In July 2024, Zaxby's started selling 16-ounce bottles of Zax Sauce, Spicy Zax Sauce and Tongue Torch at Walmart, Kroger and Winn-Dixie stores in the South and Southeast, and on Amazon. Refrigerate the bottle after opening.
